name: mairp
description: Marlon De Paz's Claude Code plugins — practical tools for AI infrastructure, security, and agent operations.

plugins.name: antares-scan
plugins.description: Fast, free, first-pass security smell test. Point a tiny local LLM (antares-1b, a ~2GB Granite-4.0 fine-tune) at a folder to get cheap vulnerability leads across a codebase in seconds — before a deeper audit. A triage aid, NOT a substitute for Semgrep, CodeQL, or Bandit.

plugins.name: mixture-of-loops
plugins.description: Derive a provenance-bound launch contract and an unattended Specstride pipeline from GitHub Spec Kit artifacts. Sources are pinned by SHA-256; editing a spec after derivation blocks the launch until the contract is regenerated.

plugins.name: qmd-recall
plugins.description: Recall from and write to a shared qmd memory gateway, so every agent in a fleet reads and adds to the same local RAG memory.

plugins.name: gpu-ops
plugins.description: Operate an RTX 3090 Thunderbolt eGPU and the local models served on it: status, safe drain and power-off, power-up, and model load checks.

plugins.name: video-to-deck
plugins.description: Turn videos into Marp slide decks (PPTX, PDF, HTML) with local Whisper, OCR and a fresh agent per video.

plugins.name: speckit-batch
plugins.description: Run a Spec Kit command (analyze, clarify, plan, ...) over a range of specs on a chosen harness, with the model and reasoning effort pinned per run, sequentially or several features in parallel.
